# Omarchy adapter for the canonical Tinted Theming Base24 Batman scheme.
# See batman-base24.yaml. The ANSI and terminal UI values below preserve the
# original Ghostty/iTerm2 Batman palette where it differs from Base24.

# Original terminal UI colors where Omarchy exposes a compatible role. Omarchy
# resolves cursor from bright_fg, so the Bat-Signal cursor remains app-specific.
accent = "#fcef0c"
foreground = "#a7a8a3"

# Canonical Base24 semantic ramp.

cyan = "#615f5e"        # base0C

darker_bg = "#1a1b1c"  # base11
bright_red = "#fff68d"      # base12

bright_cyan = "#a2a2a5"     # base15

active_border_color = "#fcef0c"

# configs retain the exact original Ghostty/iTerm2 ANSI palette.

sources.name: fuchsblau
sources.content:
# fuchsblau · omarchy-theme
# Charter v0.2 — Eine Marke aus Verzicht. Dark only. Drei gezaehlte Akzente.
#
# Semantische Palette nach Omarchy-Quattro-Spec (>= 4.0). Saemtliche
# App-Configs (Terminals, btop, neovim, vscode, shell, hyprland, ...)
# werden aus diesen Tokens generiert. Die Marke kennt acht Tokens;
# die uebrigen Werte sind ANSI-Pflichtslots und werden auf L≈0.78 C≈0.09
# in oklch gehalten — gleiche Helligkeit, gleiche Saettigung, nur die
# Hue rotiert. So bleibt die Disziplin der drei gezaehlten Stellen
# (teal, fuchs, accent-mut) erkennbar, auch wo der Terminal-Standard
# Rot und Gruen verlangt.

mode = "dark"

# ── Brand core ──────────────────────────────────────────────
accent               = "#4dd6c8"   # fuchsblau · teal — Identitaet, Focus, Signet
selection            = "#4dd6c8"   # teal — Auswahl ist Bezeichner
selection_foreground = "#1a2234"   # bg invertiert auf teal
muted                = "#4e5784"   # accent-mut — comments, muted content
hairline             = "#3a4360"   # Struktur-Hairline — Boxen, Karten, Separatoren
                                   # (btop-Boxen, shell.*.toml-Borders; kein Akzent)

background           = "#1a2234"   # fuchsblau · tief — Buehne
dark_background      = "#141a27"   # Buehne −25 % — Randzonen
darker_background    = "#0d111a"   # Buehne −50 % — Scrims
lighter_background   = "#232c44"   # bg-elev — subtle surface, cursor-line bg

foreground           = "#cdd6ee"   # body text · AAA auf bg
dark_foreground      = "#4e5784"   # accent-mut Echo — comments
light_foreground     = "#a8b1d2"   # subtext — graph labels, secondary copy
bright_foreground    = "#e0e8ff"   # peak white — zugleich Terminal-Cursor (Quattro-Vorgabe)

# ── ANSI-Pflichtslots ───────────────────────────────────────
red     = "#e89a8a"   # errors, diff minus
yellow  = "#f0a060"   # fuchs — types, warnings, "jetzt"
orange  = "#f0a060"   # fuchs — die einzige sanktionierte Warnfarbe
green   = "#86c79c"   # strings, success, diff plus
cyan    = "#4dd6c8"   # teal — operators, code spans
blue    = "#88aede"   # functions, links, info
magenta = "#c79dc9"   # keywords
brown   = "#785030"   # fuchs −50 % — aether-Pflichtslot

bright_red     = "#f0ada0"
bright_yellow  = "#f4b478"
bright_green   = "#9cd5ae"
bright_cyan    = "#6fdfd0"
bright_blue    = "#a0bee6"   # accent-hover
bright_magenta = "#d7afda"

# ── Hyprland border tokens ──────────────────────────────────
# Aktiv folgt accent (teal, Template-Fallback); inaktiv = accent-mut
# als Hairline. Auch die Shell ([hyprland]-Sektion) liest diese Tokens.
hyprland_inactive_border = "rgba(4e578499)"

sources.name: Lamplight
sources.content:
# Lamplight: a dark theme where warmth is light, never tint.
#
# Surfaces were measured off the Claude desktop UI; everything after that is
# solved rather than sampled.
#
# Three rules hold the whole thing together:
#
#   1. Warmth lives in the ink, never in the paper. Every surface below is a
#      true neutral (R=G=B). Every text colour carries a whisper of chroma at
#      OKLCH hue 103. That reads as "paper under a warm lamp" without tinting
#      the screen amber, and it is where the theme gets its name.
#   2. One voice. The clay accent is the only colour allowed to be loud, and
#      it means exactly one thing: this is what has focus.
#   3. Equal weight. The ANSI ring sits on a fixed OKLCH lightness/chroma
#      (L 0.700 / C 0.125), so hue is the only variable and no single colour
#      shouts over its neighbours. Two colours are exempt, noted below.
#
# Every colour here clears WCAG AA (4.5:1) against all four surfaces.

mode = "dark"

# The clay accent. Focus, selection, active borders, nothing else.
accent = "#d97757"

selection = "#3a3a38"
muted     = "#7a7a75"   # ANSI bright-black / comments, 4.2:1, legible but recessed

# Surface ladder. Pure neutral. Depth comes from even L* steps
# (3.0 → 5.1 → 6.8 → 11.3), not from shadows or borders.
darker_background  = "#0b0b0b"   # deepest: code blocks, lock screen
dark_background    = "#111111"   # chrome: bar, sidebars
background         = "#151515"   # canvas: terminal, app bodies
lighter_background = "#1e1e1e"   # raised: inputs, cards

# Ink. Content stays neutral; chrome and secondary text warm up as they dim,
# which is what keeps dim text from reading as dead grey.
foreground        = "#e7e7e7"   # content ink, neutral by design
bright_foreground = "#f1f1e8"   # warm white, the colour of manilla paper
light_foreground  = "#c3c2b8"   # chrome ink, the warm off-white of the UI
dark_foreground   = "#8d8d89"   # secondary / dimmed

# ANSI ring at uniform C 0.125, with lightness and hue SOLVED rather than
# hand-placed. Hand placement on a uniform-lightness ring looked coherent and
# failed in use: red sat 0.056 from the accent in OKLab, cyan drifted into
# green, and under deuteranopia a diff's + and - were 0.030 apart -- the same
# colour. Solving for maximum worst-case separation lifts the tightest pair to
# 0.115 and the diff gap to 0.084. Chroma stays uniform, so the set is still
# one family; only lightness and hue do the separating.
red     = "#d76563"   # exempt: C 0.145, since an error that fails to alarm has failed
yellow  = "#c68f32"
orange  = "#d97757"   # the accent: the palette's orange is its accent
green   = "#78bd74"
cyan    = "#1fb5bc"   # held at L 0.706; the solver wanted 0.75 and went electric
blue    = "#648ad8"
magenta = "#be80ca"
brown   = "#76503f"   # a deep, low-chroma sibling of the accent

# Bright ring: +0.085 lightness, chroma eased 5%. Emphasis, not neon.
# green sits a full 0.09 lighter than red on purpose -- under red/green colour
# blindness hue is gone and lightness is the only thing left to tell an
# addition from a deletion. Additions are the lighter of the pair, per
# convention.
bright_red     = "#f2827e"
bright_yellow  = "#e0ab57"
bright_green   = "#95d891"
bright_cyan    = "#42d2d8"
bright_blue    = "#7fa5f1"
bright_magenta = "#d89ce4"

# The focused window is the only window wearing colour. Unfocused edges are
# felt rather than seen, 1.2:1 against the canvas.
hyprland_active_border   = "rgb(d97757)"
hyprland_inactive_border = "rgb(262626)"

sources.name: Nujabes
sources.content:
# Nujabes — derived from Nujabes-wallpaper-1440p.png
#
# The wallpaper is a two-lobe palette: a fire arc (yellow -> orange -> red)
# and a violet arc (indigo -> orchid -> magenta -> rose), over near-black.
# Hues 75-240 are entirely absent, so `green` is pulled from the olive
# foliage on the left panel and `cyan` is a muted steel-teal chosen to stay
# legible next to `blue` without inventing a color the artwork never uses.
#
# Keep every comment on its own line. Omawrite's colors.toml parser gives up
# on a trailing comment after a value -- `accent = "#b26ac6"  # orchid` -- and
# falls back to a grey that is nearly invisible on this background. Inline
# comments are valid TOML and every other Omarchy app handles them, but none
# of the stock themes use them, so the bug goes unnoticed.

mode = "dark"

# orchid, the violet smoke
accent = "#b26ac6"
# deep violet
selection = "#3d2456"
# dusty violet-grey
muted = "#6b5268"

background = "#0d0a11"
dark_background = "#09070c"
darker_background = "#050407"
lighter_background = "#231a2b"

# bone
foreground = "#e3dcda"
dark_foreground = "#7d747a"
light_foreground = "#c9c0bd"
# vinyl white
bright_foreground = "#fdf7f7"

red = "#c56e6f"
yellow = "#e0c25a"
orange = "#e88b2c"
# olive foliage
green = "#9aa06b"
# not in the artwork; muted so it never fights the palette
cyan = "#7fa8b0"
# indigo
blue = "#6d4fd0"
magenta = "#dc7fcc"
brown = "#6e4a2c"

bright_red = "#dd8189"
bright_yellow = "#f2e06a"
bright_green = "#b6bb85"
bright_cyan = "#9cc3ca"
bright_blue = "#8f74e8"
bright_magenta = "#e79ad8"

# Borders: violet smoke bleeding into the amber strands, like the artwork.
hyprland_active_border = "rgba(b26ac6ee) rgba(e88b2cee) 45deg"
hyprland_inactive_border = "rgba(2a1f33aa)"

active_border_color = "#b26ac6"
active_tab_background = "#3d2456"

sources.name: Omacarchy
sources.content:
# ~/.config/alacritty/alacritty.yml
# Omacharchy - macOS-inspired Pure Grayscale Theme

[colors]

# ===============================
# Primary
# ===============================
[colors.primary]
background     = "#1C1C1E"   # Dark graphite background
foreground     = "#FFFFFF"   # White text for maximum readability
dim_foreground = "#A0A0A0"   # Medium gray for less important text
bright_foreground = "#FFFFFF"

# ===============================
# Cursor
# ===============================
[colors.cursor]
text   = "#1C1C1E"           # Matches terminal background
cursor = "#FFFFFF"           # White cursor for clarity

[colors.vi_mode_cursor]
text   = "#1C1C1E"
cursor = "#FFFFFF"

# ===============================
# Search highlights
# ===============================
[colors.search.matches]
foreground = "#FFFFFF"
background = "#808080"       # Medium gray highlight

[colors.search.focused_match]
foreground = "#FFFFFF"
background = "#A0A0A0"       # Slightly lighter gray focus

# ===============================
# Footer / Hints
# ===============================
[colors.footer_bar]
foreground = "#FFFFFF"
background = "#2C2C2E"       # Dark gray separator

[colors.hints.start]
foreground = "#FFFFFF"
background = "#A0A0A0"       # Medium gray hints

[colors.hints.end]
foreground = "#FFFFFF"
background = "#C0C0C0"       # Light gray hints

# ===============================
# Selection / highlight
# ===============================
[colors.selection]
text       = "#FFFFFF"
background = "#808080"       # Medium gray selection

# ===============================
# Normal ANSI Colors (all gray shades)
# ===============================
[colors.normal]
black   = "#1C1C1E"
red     = "#4A4A4A"
green   = "#5A5A5A"
yellow  = "#6A6A6A"
blue    = "#7A7A7A"
magenta = "#8A8A8A"
cyan    = "#9A9A9A"
white   = "#FFFFFF"

# ===============================
# Bright ANSI Colors (lighter grays)
# ===============================
[colors.bright]
black   = "#2C2C2E"
red     = "#555555"
green   = "#666666"
yellow  = "#777777"
blue    = "#888888"
magenta = "#999999"
cyan    = "#AAAAAA"
white   = "#F2F2F2"

# ===============================
# Indexed colors for accents (all gray)
# ===============================
[[colors.indexed_colors]]
index = 16
color = "#BBBBBB"

[[colors.indexed_colors]]
index = 17
color = "#DDDDDD"

sources.name: Quattrocento Light
sources.content:
# Quattrocento Light — a page from the notebook, not the painting
# Iron gall on parchment. Tonal, not contrasting: the signal sits one step
# from the ground instead of across from it. Every chromatic is a pigment
# that a workshop could actually grind in 1500.

mode                     = "light"

# Signal, selection and the de-emphasised ramp
accent                   = "#8a4a2c"
selection                = "#ddcdab"
muted                    = "#8a7a5e"

# Ground, from the deepest surface up to the elevated one
background               = "#f0e6d3"
dark_background          = "#e4d8c0"
darker_background        = "#d8c9ad"
lighter_background       = "#e9dfc9"

# Text, from de-emphasised up to the cursor
foreground               = "#33291b"
dark_foreground          = "#7a6a50"
light_foreground         = "#4c3f2c"
bright_foreground        = "#1c150c"

# Window borders. Sanguine into iron gall — the two media of the drawing.
hyprland_active_border   = "rgba(8a4a2cee) rgba(33291bee) 45deg"
hyprland_inactive_border = "rgba(d8c9adaa)"

# Named colours, each one a real Renaissance pigment
red                      = "#a32d2a"  # vermilion
orange                   = "#95521a"  # burnt ochre
yellow                   = "#7d5a10"  # orpiment
green                    = "#3f6b4a"  # verdigris
cyan                     = "#3a6367"  # blue-verditer
blue                     = "#3f5378"  # indigo, from woad
magenta                  = "#8c3a58"  # madder lake
brown                    = "#6b4a2c"  # raw umber

# Bright variants. Darker, not lighter — this ground is light.
bright_red               = "#8e2622"
bright_yellow            = "#6d4e0c"
bright_green             = "#355c3f"
bright_cyan              = "#2f5457"
bright_blue              = "#354764"
bright_magenta           = "#752f49"

sources.name: felix
sources.content:
accent = "#ff8852"          # Omarchy UI accent: links, focused controls, active states // obsidian checkbox /  btop bottom left border & shortcuts
cursor = "#e7e9ea"          # Cursor color in terminal templates
foreground = "#e7e9ea"      # Primary text color used across Omarchy templates 
background = "#000000"      # Default background for terminals and themed UI surfaces

selection_foreground = "#000000"    # Text color for selections (terminal + UI selection states)
selection_background = "#e7e9ea"    # Selection background used in terminal templates

# Base16-aligned 16-color palette.
# Omarchy templates map these to terminal color0-15 and Base16 base00-base0F.
# Keep the semantic roles in mind when swapping colors.

color0  = "#121212"  # base00 - Deep background; primary canvas for terminals
color1  = "#8a8a8a"  # base08 - Error/critical accents (alerts, destructive states) // Terminal writable / obsidian H1 / btop bottom left border / compressed files
color2  = "#e7e9ea"  # base0B - Success/positive accents (ok, added, confirm) // Terminal executible, size & pdf files / obsidian H2 / Fastfetch logo & hardware icons / btop middle border
color3  = "#9e9e9e"  # base0A - Warning/attention accents // Terminal readable & username / obsidian H3 / download monitor
color4  = "#626262"  # base0D - Primary accent (links, active, emphasis) // Terminal directory, folder name, date modified / fastfetch software icons / btop cpu monitor
color5  = "#8a8a8a"  # base0E - Secondary accent (special highlights) // Terminal image files / btop top border / fastfetch bottom icons
color6  = "#767676"  # base0C - Informational accents (hints, secondary highlights) // Terminal prompt / audio files / btop cpu monitor, percent, program/memory top gradient, used/cache memory, download bottom monitor
color7  = "#e0e0e0"  # base05 - Default foreground for terminal text

color8  = "#626262"  # base03 - Dim text, inactive UI, subtle borders // Obsidian icons, titles & interior borders / terminal dashes / fastfetch 3x box borders / btop cpu meter, top right border, left interior borders, processes bottom gradient, download border
color9  = "#9e9e9e"  # base08 - Bright/error variant (often same as color1)
color10 = "#767676"  # base0B - Bright/success variant (often same as color2)
color11 = "#b2b2b2"  # base0A - Bright/warning variant
color12 = "#626262"  # base0D - Bright primary accent variant
color13 = "#8a8a8a"  # base0E - Bright secondary accent variant
color14 = "#9e9e9e"  # base0C - Bright informational accent variant
color15 = "#e7e9ea"  # base07 - Highest-contrast text for headers and strong emphasis
